leave_alone_priors.flag9_repair_deferred: research/p104-flag9-head-step-repair DEFER; census uses published word only

theorem.statement: On the published native-channel word, every checked present-head strict I-G/2 side-correction entry among flags {1,9,43} (each primary flag entry plus five additional off-diagonal nonzero Gram sources on that target row; 18 entries) has all insertion-class zero-mass placements obstructed by a least-frame/class-Z forward sweep, and each source is forced outside the target final hyperplane by at least one initial X-head. Endpoint-restoring non-private nested transports contribute even rank mass, so the strict non-private side-correction floor is +2 for every checked entry. No counterexample was found.
